response.disabledBanner: Query-response cache disabled (store: {{storeType}}). Query results are not cached in Redis, so the counters below stay at zero. Hot-table and materialized-store caching are separate layers (see the other tabs) and are unaffected.

hot.description: Small lookup tables mirrored in Redis (or in-memory) and inlined as VALUES CTEs to optimize JOINs. Always available regardless of the response-cache store.
hot.empty: No hot tables loaded or registered as candidates.
hot.busyDescription: A table whose Replicate setting is Default or a Hot threshold is replicated once the statements that read it pass its threshold; reads then come from the replica, and return to the source when traffic falls below half the threshold. While its first replica is being built the table is still read live.

materialized.description: Durable store where non-attachable sources land and materialized views are written. Distinct from the response cache and the hot tier; a query can use any combination of the three.
